note: Funnel structure: open-ended first, then prompted, then explicit. Question order matters — do not reorder.

questions.text: Overall, how would you rate your experience in this study?
Thinking back across all of your sessions, did anything about the AI seem to change over time? Describe anything you noticed, however small.
Did you notice any changes in HOW the AI communicated — its style, tone, or formatting — across your sessions?
options: No, it seemed the same throughout
I thought I noticed something but wasn't sure
Yes, I noticed a clear change

questions.text: If you noticed any changes in the AI's communication, please describe what you observed and roughly when it happened.
For some participants, the AI's communication style changed partway through the study. If you experienced a change, which did you prefer?
Outside of this study, how often do you use AI assistants (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini)?
Which AI assistants do you use most often?
Any final thoughts or feedback about the study?
